# Bid Work Flow Template

A bid work flow template for managing bidding processes online using Google Docs.

## Overview

This template provides a structured workflow for bid management and processing.

## Resources

- **[Bid Work Flow Template](https://docs.google.com/drawings/edit?id=1_IxdXg3VxXh6ouu8Dx0MaXVph1aH8DCkbxJNcnKyQGw&hl=en&authkey=CKGy0soH)** - Google Docs Format

### Instructions

Log into your Google Account to make and edit your own copy of the template.

## Features

- Structured workflow for bid management
- Collaborative editing through Google Docs
- Easy customization for your specific needs
- Online access from anywhere

**Note:** Click the link above to access and use the Bid Work Flow Template in Google Docs.
